title: If you love your kids and grandkids …
excerpt: … you don’t want them to live in a world devastated by global warming and all the political and economic chaos it will create. That’s why it’s worth educating yourself with this short video about why Congress won’t act. Thanks, Sen. Sheldon Whitehouse!
